The '''Sarrish Defense Force''' was a defense force<ref name="ROTS TVD" /> servicing the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Hard Merchandise">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref> [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]]<ref name="ROTS TVD" /> by [[19 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="formation note" /> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Veedaaz Awmetth/Legends|Veedaaz Awmetth]], a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of Sarrish<ref name="Ask Lobot">{{InsiderCite|102|Ask Lobot}}</ref> who represented the Vensensor [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|veedaaz|Awmetth, Veedaaz}}</ref> wore a Sarrish Defense Force [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]]<ref name="ROTS TVD" /> to the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of his colleague [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]<ref name="DB" /> on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sarrish Defense Force was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="ROTS TVD" /> and released on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="ROTS TVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|oldversion=20151018025119}}</ref>
